name: Stone vault hide
label: Hides
lead: Hide shaped like a grey stone vault, with a wide entrance and a layered flat top - a neutral shelter for the warm or cool side of the terrarium.

description.html: This hide looks like a vault of grey stone with brownish highlights. The top is layered and flat, like stacked stone slabs, and below it a wide, rounded entrance leads into a roomy interior.

The wide entrance makes it easier for stockier animals to get in, such as broad-bodied lizards, and the flat top serves as a resting spot. The neutral grey-brown color fits almost any substrate and other decor, so this is a good basic hide that is easy to combine with other pieces.

Animals regulate their body temperature by moving between the warmer and cooler parts of the terrarium. If they have only one hide, they often choose security over the right temperature. That is why at least two hides per terrarium are recommended. This vault can be one of them, on the warm or the cool side.
Place the hide directly on the floor and fill the substrate around it. Check the inside once a week, since animals sometimes defecate in their hide, and wash it with warm water.
